summary: Eltek Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release of first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing reports revenues of $10.4 million, an operating loss of $1.9 million, and a net loss of $2.9 million ($0.42 per share). No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is disclosed. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation. As a non-US issuer, this 6-K is the equivalent of a US Form 8-K Item 2.02 earnings release.
